mostWorthwhile.text: Placing the framed panels was most worthwhile: the explanation made clear why rails spread wheel loads where loose mesh would sink.

leastWorthwhile.text: Anchoring and then combining the winch with the panels felt somewhat procedural, especially with only one gameplay action offered at each point.

surprise.text: The short panels needed supported ground and firm approaches, rather than simply being laid over unsupported soft ground.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary; the winch and panels both had understandable roles, although the final combination was the only offered action.

continue.text: Yes. The crossing was brief and physically explained, and I would be curious to see what the farther ice sample reveals.
